terra.problem: The explanation repeats the same fact several times without adding much personality or insight.
Saying troubled and rested don't go together adds an unsupported conclusion. Pharaoh's troubled spirit does not establish whether he was rested.
The captain of the guard is mentioned later, but the passage does not say he personally shows up.
The explanation guesses why Pharaoh stresses the cows' appearance. Reasons cannot be added unless the text gives them, even when marked as a guess.
The broken-down car comparison makes the devastating famine sound like an ordinary inconvenience.
